title: Claims Dashboard | Banking Error | Payment Failed | Customer Returns | Re-Processing | Code 64 Crew Shortage | Delay 6�9h (7h) | APPR | Basic Aeroplan
description: Eligible claim was submitted and payment initiated for a 7-hour delay (6�<9h band, APPR Tier 2: $700 CAD) caused by Code 64 (Flight Crew Shortage � Controllable) on a domestic flight. Passenger holds a Basic Aeroplan profile (9876543210). Payment processor attempts $700 CAD Interac e-Transfer, but the bank rejects the payment (account closed). Customer receives notification and returns to chatbot to update banking details. Identity is re-verified via OTP (IDV already passed on original submission). Payment is re-processed to the new email address. Validates: (1) Payment failure handling and status updates for a Tier 2 APPR claim, (2) Re-authentication on customer return, (3) IDV bypass when already completed, (4) Successful re-processing of $700 CAD payout, (5) Dashboard payment audit history tracking.
